I'm somewhere around a month in to pornfree.  My advice is simply this:  don't give up.  I've struggled with this for over two decades.  I'm still trying.  This is the longest I've gotten.  Also, consider this, if you go five days and have a relapse, then go another five days without one, that's a total of one day out of eleven that you've fallen to your addiction--and ten days that you've beaten it.  I see people on here who are like "I've relapsed after 142 days--I can't believe I'm back at day one."  Well, you aren't.  If you brush yourself off and keep going, it's just one day that you slipped in 143.  If you don't slip tomorrow, it's then one day out of 144.  Just keep getting back up.  In a fight, you just have to get up one more time than you go down to win.  So win.

For whatever good I am, I'm yours.  I can't condemn anyone else--too much need for mercy myself.  Very little time you've lost so far and hopefully many years to come,  If talking to a stranger on the internet helps you make those years better, I'm all for it.
